title: Cloud-based project management

captions.instagram:
What if you could see every build in real time? What I'd want from cloud-based project management: one shared view, problems flagged earlier, faster decisions.

Cloud-based is one of the four pillars of BUILT®.

Save the 5 questions for any project dashboard.

#ConstructionTech #ProjectManagement #Cloud

Which metric would you watch?
captions.facebook:
Scattered updates or one real-time view? I compared the two, and listed five questions for any project dashboard.

#ProjectManagement #ConstructionTech

How do you track projects today?
captions.linkedin:
The goal of project software is faster decisions, not more reports.

Cloud-based project management gives everyone one version of the truth: the same plan and the same status, with problems showing up earlier. Data becomes a dashboard, and the dashboard drives a decision.

Cloud-based is one of the four pillars of BUILT®.

Five questions I'd ask of any dashboard: Who can see it? How current is the data? What triggers an alert? Who acts on it? What gets reviewed weekly?

#ProjectManagement #ConstructionTech

Which question does your current setup fail?
captions.x:
Data → dashboard → decision.

The point of a project dashboard is faster decisions, not more reports. That's the bar I'd hold it to.

What would you put on yours?
